init.title: Marstek communication
init.description: Tune polling to match your network. Default fast interval is 60 seconds. A 4 second delay between UDP requests is recommended on Wi-Fi.

data_description.scan_interval: How often ES.GetMode and PV.GetStatus are polled (default: 60 s). Minimum: 10 s.
data_description.medium_scan_interval: How often ES.GetStatus energy counters are refreshed (default: 300 s).
data_description.request_delay: Pause between consecutive API calls within one poll cycle (default: 4 s).
data_description.request_timeout: Per-request UDP timeout before retry (default: 5 s).
data_description.staleness_threshold: Missed category updates before a sensor shows unknown (default: 3 cycles).
data_description.unavailable_after_seconds: Seconds without any successful poll before entities become unavailable (default: 600 s).
data_description.startup_delay: Wait after Home Assistant load before the first UDP poll (default: 45 s). Helps avoid disturbing feed-in on reload.
